verdict.rationale: The models overview documents context windows per model, and there is a dedicated context-windows guide. The changelog gives exact figures for the flagship (1M context, 128k max output tokens). `GET /v1/models` returns per-model `max_input_tokens` and `max_tokens`, so limits are both exact and machine-queryable rather than marketing ranges. Missing for 10: the evidence does not show a full per-model input/output limit table for every model (only flagship figures are quoted), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that the published limits match actual behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, every model's context window and token budgets are documented precisely — input/output limits per model, not marketing ranges

citations.quote: Context windows documented per model on the overview ("Context window — 1M tokens") with a dedicated context-windows guide
It has a 1M token context window by default, 128k max output tokens
`GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` now return `max_input_tokens`, `max_tokens`, and a `capabilities` object.
